content.title: Queue CSV exports from each export action

check.operand: a success toast confirming the selected export action

content.test_md_blob:
# Queue CSV exports from each export action

> Prove each export action can be queued while the default CSV format remains selected and a success toast is shown.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} and land on the portfolio dashboard view where the Export control is available.

## Step 2

Open the Export popover and verify the action list shows Export Current View, Export Holdings, Export Transactions, and Export Risk Report, with an icon and a description on each action row.

## Step 3

In the same popover, verify the Format section shows CSV, JSON, and PDF and that CSV is selected by default.

## Step 4

Queue Export Current View, Export Holdings, Export Transactions, and Export Risk Report one at a time without changing the selected format from CSV; after each selection, confirm a success toast appears for the queued export action and reopen the Export popover if it closes before the next action.

## Step 5 — assert @verifies ac-118, ac-119, ac-120, ac-121, ac-122, ac-123, ac-124, ac-125

Confirm presence check: a success toast confirming the selected export action (exists) — the stated promise: Selecting any export action displays a success toast for the queued export action.

    step: 1
  - objective: Open the Export popover and verify the action list shows Export Current View, Export Holdings, Export Transactions, and Export Risk Report, with an icon and a description on each action row.
    step: 2
  - objective: In the same popover, verify the Format section shows CSV, JSON, and PDF and that CSV is selected by default.
    step: 3
  - objective: Queue Export Current View, Export Holdings, Export Transactions, and Export Risk Report one at a time without changing the selected format from CSV; after each selection, confirm a success toast appears for the queued export action and reopen the Export popover if it closes before the next action.
    step: 4
  - check:
      expected_mode: authored
      kind: presence
      operand: a success toast confirming the selected export action
      operator: exists
      review_required: false
      verified_against: ac-118
    objective: 'Confirm presence check: a success toast confirming the selected export action (exists) — the stated promise: Selecting any export action displays a success toast for the queued export action.'
    step: 5
scenario: Queue CSV exports from each export action
title: Queue CSV exports from each export action

judgements.rationale: [value_score] Scored highest because it proves the core promised outcome: choosing an export action on the default path yields the success toast across the complete action set.
[value_score] Scored next because it proves the shared initial-state contract that every export path depends on before any action is queued.
[value_score] Scored just below the default path because it proves the first non-default format selection and confirms the selected state changes to JSON before export.
[value_score] Scored just below the JSON path because it proves the second non-default format selection and confirms the selected state changes to PDF before export.

[self_critique] Oracle-proves pass: the primary check stayed anchored to ac-118's toast promise, while the steps explicitly required success feedback after each of the four action selections so the sweep did not collapse into a single-action proof.

[self_critique] Technique-fit pass: static rendered-state inspection matched this scenario's initial-state promises better than a state-flow or negative technique would have, because the source defined a popover layout and default selection only.
[self_critique] Negative-case pass: no invalid-format or failed-export case was added because the source never described an error path, and inventing one would have exceeded the evidence.

[self_critique] Over-broad-assert pass: the final check stayed narrow to the path-specific PDF selected state from ac-127, and the test did not claim that a real file download must or must not occur because the source only required fake success feedback.
